# spectral_smooth_3d { #mofography.helper.spectral_smooth_3d }

```python
helper.spectral_smooth_3d(dgrid, atoms, grid_spacing, sigma=1.0)
```

Smooth a 3D grid using spectral filtering with proper handling of non-orthogonal cells.



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

dgrid : np.ndarray
    3D density grid
atoms : ase.Atoms
    ASE Atoms object containing cell information
grid_spacing : float
    Grid spacing in Angstroms (assumed uniform)
sigma : float
    Smoothing parameter in Angstroms
    


## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

np.ndarray
    Smoothed 3D grid
